metadata.case_name: KHAN AMIR v. KWOK YUI CHOR AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: general laborer in factories and warehouses
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: light to moderate manual work such as machine operator, security guard, cleaning worker, shop-keeper
plaintiff.education_level: educated up to the primary level

injuries.description: fracture of third lumbar spine vertebral body
source: X-ray of lumbar spine showed fracture of third lumbar spine vertebral body.

injuries.description: multiple fracture in the spine including 2nd to 5th lumbar spine associated with lower limb weakness
source: There was multiple fracture in the spine including 2nd to 5th lumbar spine associated with lower limb weakness.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple fractures of lumbar spine or pelvis

source: (a) Injury: BANK INJURY RESULTING IN (i) FRACTURE OF L3 AND L4; (ii) BACK STIFFNESS AND PAIN
injuries.icd_description: Multiple fractures of lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: residual deformity of L3 and L4 vertebrae, ankylosis L2 and L3
source: Radiological examination of the lumbar spine shows residual deformity of L3 and L4 vertebrae, ankylosis L2 and L3.

injuries.description: L3 burst fracture with bulging posterior L3 body with indentation onto the thecal sac narrowing the space of the spinal canal
source: as the L3 burst fracture was found to have bulging posterior L3 body with indentation onto the thecal sac narrowing the space of the spinal canal

manifestations.description: lumbar spine lordotic curve is reduced
active movement is very much reduced
tenderness over the lower lumbar spine
left dorsal foot tender and swollen
lower limb weakness (initially), motor power recovered after 2 days
no objective neurological deficit found over his lower limbs (on later examination)
subjective sense of reduced sensation right lower limb (probably non-specific radicular symptom)

treatments_received: admitted to Orthopaedic and Traumatology Ward
transfer to Pok Oi Hospital for rehabilitation
treatments_future: orthopaedic consultation (about 5 times in one year for increased risk)
physiotherapy (20 sessions per year for 5 years suggested for increased risk)

losses.description: Difficulty climbing stairs, difficulty with squatting, reduced active movement and stiffness
Not fit to return to pre-accident job as a metal work laborer; restricted to light to moderate manual work
Pre-trial loss of earning and MPF: $139,077 (as awarded)
Future loss of earning and MPF: $206,917 (as awarded)
Special damages (medical and travelling expenses): $5,000 (as awarded)
